headline: Phase 3 Cancer Vaccine Success Could Change The Case For Moderna Stock
summary: Moderna was recently added to the Nasdaq-100 Index after positive Phase 3 data for its personalized cancer vaccine with Merck highlighted a pivot toward oncology beyond COVID-focused products. The late-stage success of intismeran positions Moderna's mRNA platform as a potential multi-product franchise across cancer and other conditions rather than a single-therapy story. Next, the focus turns to how this cancer vaccine progress could reshape Moderna's broader investment narrative around...

headline: What Was Eli Lilly Telling You Before Its Stock Ran?
summary: An investor who put $10,000 into Eli Lilly (LLY) stock on October 14, 2025 held about $15,500 by October 15, 2026. Placing that same sum in the S&P 500 over the identical period would have yielded about $11,790. By mid-2026, two drugs, Zepbound and Mounjaro, accounted for most of the company's sales. How early did those two drugs show up in what Lilly said and filed.

headline: When Amgen's Forecast And Chart Say The Same Thing, Pay Attention
summary: Amgen (AMGN) raised its revenue forecast for fiscal 2026 on August 4. Since the market close before that release, the stock has gained 15.2%, outpacing the 1.9% return of the S&P 500. A higher forecast or a climbing share price means little in isolation. When the corporate numbers and the technical chart align, however, the combination warrants closer scrutiny. So how far did management raise its forecast, and why.

headline: Gilead’s HIV Prevention Business Just Topped $1 Billion A Quarter. What Comes Next?
summary: Gilead Sciences (GILD) built its foundation on HIV treatment. Biktarvy alone accounted for $14.3 billion of the company's $29.4 billion in fiscal 2025 revenue. Yet another segment of the HIV business is growing at a much faster pace, and it targets people who do not currently carry the virus. Gilead expects a regulatory decision regarding a new option in this category in early 2027. So what is that business, and how much is it selling today.

headline: Is Amgen Stock Increasing Your Market Risk?
summary: Investors holding shares of Amgen (AMGN), the $234 billion maker of drugs such as Repatha and Prolia, likely pair that position with broad exposure to the S&P 500. As the broader market rises and falls each day, the pharmaceutical stock's individual performance blends with the rest of that capital. So when the market drops, does Amgen make your losses bigger.
